data.narrative:
Steady Energy is a Series G climate and energy technology company that has raised €32M to date. The valuation landscape for frontier-energy ventures remains fragmented; while eight private peers operate in Climate & Energy (including names like Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, and KoBold Metals), none share sufficient stage and valuation proximity to Steady Energy to support a robust peer-median analysis. A single public comparable exists in the sector.

Given the constraint on peer triangulation, Stage-Progression methodology applies a standard 1.25x step-up multiplier typical of Series G-stage advancement to the €32M raised proxy, yielding $40M. This method assumes Steady Energy follows conventional venture funding velocity and that capital deployment correlates with value creation—assumptions reasonable but not validated by comp data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M (floor, incorporating modest fundraising dilution) to $46M (ceiling, reflecting upside scenario), with $40M as the point estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable late-stage benchmarks in the subsector, which limits calibration of the step-up multiplier, and the unproven commercial traction or unit economics of the business. A narrower range would require either proprietary metrics (revenue, gross margin, customer concentration) or additional late-stage climate-tech precedents with disclosed valuations.
